about: Scheduled US releases that can move ethereum suddenly. Times are New York time (24-hour). A 15-minute market is skipped if it touches [release - 5 min, release + 30 min]. Enforced only above $10 per trade; at $10 it is logged as advisory. Sources: bls.gov/schedule/2026, federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar (checked 2026-11-04). Add new dates in the same format; the app warns when the list is about to run out.
